trans-unit.source: Replace-URL to show Klaro! Consent Management:Links targeting this placeholder URL are automatically modified before HTML output. The URL is replaced with CSP-compliant JavaScript to trigger the Klaro! Consent Management modal.
trans-unit.target: URL-ionaid gus riaghladh cead Klaro! a shealltainn: Thèid ceanglaichean a tha ag amas air an URL gleidhidh-àite seo atharrachadh gu fèin-obrachail mus tèid HTML a chur a-mach. Thèid JavaScript a tha co-chòrdail ri CSP a chur an àite an URL gus modal riaghladh cead Klaro! fhosgladh.

trans-unit.source: Replace-URL to reset Klaro! Consent Management:Links targeting this placeholder URL are automatically changed before HTML output. The URL is replaced with CSP-compliant JavaScript to reset the Klaro! Consent Management settings and then trigger the modal.
trans-unit.target: URL-ionaid gus riaghladh cead Klaro! ath-shuidheachadh: Thèid ceanglaichean a tha ag amas air an URL gleidhidh-àite seo atharrachadh gu fèin-obrachail mus tèid HTML a chur a-mach. Thèid JavaScript a tha co-chòrdail ri CSP a chur an àite an URL gus roghainnean riaghladh cead Klaro! ath-shuidheachadh agus an uairsin am modal fhosgladh.

trans-unit.source: Klaro! Configuration Path:If this path is set, external applications can use the Klaro! configuration generated by TYPO3. For example, a WordPress installation can load the TYPO3-generated configuration from this path. Example: "/klaro-config.js"
trans-unit.target: Slighe rèiteachaidh Klaro!: Ma tha an t-slighe seo suidhichte, faodaidh aplacaidean taobh a-muigh an rèiteachadh Klaro! a chruthaich TYPO3 a chleachdadh. Mar eisimpleir, faodaidh stàladh WordPress an rèiteachadh a chruthaich TYPO3 a luchdadh on t-slighe seo. Eisimpleir: "/klaro-config.js"

trans-unit.source: Replace attributes:Comma-separated list of attributes that should be automatically replaced within the content element of the contextual consent
trans-unit.target: Cuir buadhan an àite:Liosta de bhuadhan air an sgaradh le cromagan a bu chòir a chur an àite gu fèin-obrachail taobh a-staigh eileamaid susbaint a’ chead cho-theacsail

trans-unit.source: Main section only:Activate this option if the contextual consent box should be limited to the main content only (without heading and footer).
trans-unit.target: Prìomh earrann a-mhàin:Cuir an roghainn seo an gnìomh ma bu chòir bogsa a’ chead cho-theacsail a chuingealachadh ris a’ phrìomh shusbaint a-mhàin (gun cheann agus bonn-duilleige).
